description: Source code for LocationCaptureManager class that manages retrieval of device location using Android's LocationManager, including permission checks, caching, and timeout handling.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages the retrieval of device location with permission validation, caching, and timeout handling.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager.Payload
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the location payload in JSON format.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves the current location, either from cache or via fresh request, formatted as JSON payload.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Checks for the most recent cached location within specified age and required permissions.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests a fresh location fix with a specified timeout, provider selection, and permission checks.
